title: browser.user_action
description: Host -> bridge, unsolicited, no reply. Reports trusted user activity on an agent-readable page. Sent only in live mode; continues while handed over. Scrolling and password-field typing are never reported.

req_id.description: Generated by the host; logging only.

count.description: click: clicks coalesced; nav: navigations coalesced; otherwise 1.

added.description: Newly visible text lines since the last report, joined by newline, de-duplicated; may be empty. Over-long text keeps the head and ends with an ellipsis.

You step inside.
